description: Wuhan City partial road network data and POI dataset is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors 富康 毛. 该数据集是武汉市某些区域的路网和POI的综合数据集。数据以SHP格式提供，精度高，拓扑一致性强，可直接用于GIS空间分析、城市规划模拟等相关领域的数据分析和模型构建。. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 526733045 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
